name: Octree Node Insertion and Parent Finding
definition: Traverses the octree to find the parent node of a specific coordinate (x,y,z) at a given detail level, creating intermediate nodes if they do not exist.
summary: This algorithm dynamically grows a sparse voxel octree by traversing to locate or create a parent node for a coordinate, differing from static voxelization by allocating nodes on-demand rather than pre-allocating a fixed grid.
